description: Research every simulation-relevant actor as a provenance-bound intelligence profile and deliver that actor's relevant history, incentives, values, capabilities, motivations, preferences, alliances, competitors, plans, actions, investments, constraints, uncertainties, and global research context into the exact OASIS-consumed persona without weakening safety or reproducibility.
steps: Start a deep-research run and identify the canonical actor roster with stable actor IDs and aliases.

For every actor eligible for the simulation cast, gather actor-specific evidence covering history, incentives, values, capabilities, motivations, preferences, alliances, competitors, future plans, expected actions, investments, constraints, vulnerabilities, decision rules, and uncertainties.
Bind every material actor claim to source identities, recency/as-of metadata, confidence or evidence-gap state, and the initiating research contract.
Include decision-relevant actor plans, incentives, investments, likely actions, conflicts, and dependencies in the unified deep-research report and structured actor artifacts.
Persist a versioned actor-intelligence contract whose hashes and provenance participate in research manifest validation and stage reuse.
Compile the structured intelligence into a bounded actor-role contract while preserving declarative-data boundaries and rejecting prompt-control content.

Pass each actor only its own relevant intelligence plus a bounded, forecast-relevant global research context, scenario context, and relationships; do not substitute one generic report summary for all actors.
Verify the exact actor-specific context reaches Reddit persona and Twitter user_char fields and remains distinct across actors and platforms.
Fail closed on identity mismatch, tampered hashes, malformed contracts, or missing required evidence; represent sparse evidence explicitly without fabricating detail.
Exercise fresh, reuse, sparse, adversarial, multi-actor, and runtime-tamper scenarios with focused and cross-stage tests, then update documentation and continuity evidence.

description: The supported localhost launcher opens one DeepResearchForecast research UI directly and preserves correct routing, readiness, navigation, accessibility, and no-duplicate-run behavior.
steps: Launch the application through the supported npm start workflow without manually starting Vite or Flask.
Verify exactly one browser tab opens and the root URL renders ResearchView rather than the legacy MiroFish page.
Load /research, refresh the root and alias routes, use browser back and forward, and load an unknown route.
Click the DeepResearchForecast brand and verify it stays in or safely resets the research workflow rather than navigating to /legacy.
Exercise prompt entry, advanced controls, settings, history, confirmation dialogs, workspace tabs, and progress surfaces by keyboard at desktop and mobile widths.
Verify launcher readiness, console and network health, responsive overflow, accessible names and focus behavior, and that navigation never duplicates POST /api/research/run.

description: Every provider request across research, graph, simulation, report, retry, ensemble, translation, and resume lineage is counted exactly once with explicit measured or estimated provenance.
steps: Replay a same-message-ID usage snapshot that grows after subagent completion and verify positive-delta accounting records the final cumulative usage without duplication.

Persist per-call pipeline, attempt, stage, substage, lane, phase, provider, model, local logical call ID, provider request ID metadata, input/output/cache tokens, latency, retry, outcome, and cost fields.
Assign one local immutable logical call ID to every provider call while retaining provider request IDs and LangGraph message IDs only as reconciliation metadata.
Merge research, Graphiti, OASIS, report, translation, extraction, audit, and ensemble child-process records into one immutable lineage ledger.
Distinguish current-attempt, cumulative-lineage, measured-lower-bound, and estimated totals after retries and resumes.
Reconcile each stage and the complete pipeline as the sum of unique local logical call IDs and reject double-counted synthetic aggregates.

description: Users can see truthful live stage health, time, spend, and remaining budget, and cross-process token/cost budgets stop new calls without corrupting resumable work.
steps: Expose elapsed stage time, approximate ETA, heartbeat age, owner health, stale state, measured or estimated tokens, cost, and budget remaining through the status API.
Render a compact live health and cost panel above the pipeline timeline with explicit unknown and stale states.
Apply one durable pipeline-and-attempt budget across research, graph, simulation, and report subprocesses.
Race parallel provider fixtures at the remaining-budget boundary and verify atomic reservations prevent every worker from independently passing the same pre-call check.
Cross a budget in an offline provider fixture and verify the next request is rejected with a typed durable receipt while completed artifacts remain resumable.
Verify a provider outage or stale heartbeat stops boundedly and cannot issue a duplicate run or unbounded retry storm.

description: Base pipelines, scenario forks, and resumes resolve every dossier, translation, PDF, editing, progress, visualization, and report API through the state-authoritative shared handoff directory.
steps: Create offline base-pipeline and scenario-fork states where the fork intentionally points at the base handoff directory.
Read dossier, translation, PDF, edit, progress, visualization, and report surfaces through both base and fork pipeline IDs.
Verify every route resolves state.handoff_dir with a safe pipeline-local fallback only for compatible legacy state.
Tamper with handoff identity, hashes, or attempt lineage and verify reuse fails closed rather than reading unrelated bytes.
Verify resume and fork operations preserve the same artifact authority in both internal orchestration and external APIs.

description: Polymarket evidence can influence a forecast only when equivalence and confidence are retained, and selected markets carry exact provenance, current price, liquidity, spread, CLOB identity, and bounded history enrichment.
steps: Feed exact or near market matches at confidence 0.49 and 0.50 through anchoring, divergence, reconciliation, and publication.
Verify the rejected 0.49 match causes no revision call and leaves probability and rationale byte-for-byte unchanged.
Require accepted market rationales to bind the exact market ID or question and quoted price, not merely contain the word market.
Align agent-tool, deterministic, report, and UI market schemas for IDs, URLs, prices, bid and ask, liquidity, volume, change, timestamps, relevance, equivalence, and confidence.
Batch-enrich only selected exact market IDs through one bounded Gamma lookup and fetch CLOB history when available, recording an explicit unavailable reason otherwise.
Map each CLOB token through its declared outcome label and use only the token for literal Yes, never an assumed first array position.
Poll unresolved, ambiguous, and resolved markets repeatedly and verify idempotent ledger updates with only unambiguous resolution becoming calibration authority.
Render research-versus-current price, freshness, equivalence, confidence, spread, history, and capture provenance in the dossier and report UI.

description: The report UI presents readable, source-bound binary, scenario, market, uncertainty, diagnostic simulation, revision, timeline, and quantitative evidence with explicit coverage limitations.
steps: Render a first-class sortable binary forecast table with resolution criteria, horizon, confidence, and source provenance.
Render scenario probabilities and ensemble uncertainty without silently inventing residual or extra scenarios.
Show market comparisons with exact contract links, equivalence, confidence, freshness, and price history.
Label world-state and other simulation trajectories as diagnostic elicited-model projections that do not update forecast probabilities.
Version visualization manifests with producer policy, generation time, input hashes, source metadata, and explicit skip reasons.
Replay saved reports and verify chronological axes, comparable units, readable labels, uncertainty, responsive layout, alt text or table alternatives, and no excessive inline Plotly duplication.

description: Graph construction avoids multi-hour timeout tails and redundant extraction while preserving a sealed, explicit degradation contract for partial graphs.
steps: Benchmark current chunk size, retry limits, community-detection defaults, resolution guards, structured seeds, and executor attribution against historical fixtures.
Inject repeated 900-second-equivalent timeouts and verify a short consecutive-timeout or provider circuit stops the stage boundedly.
Retain successful chunks, rejected-chunk counts, timeout causes, and completeness limits in a signed degradation receipt.
Use compact structured actor and relationship artifacts to avoid re-deriving already-sealed facts where equivalence is proven.
Verify downstream prepare and report stages either accept the declared partial graph under policy or fail closed deterministically.
Compare wall time, model calls, tokens, retained facts, and forecast-quality fixtures against the historical graph baseline.

description: Research continues only while a bounded pass adds independent decision-relevant evidence, closes a named gap, resolves a contradiction, or changes a forecast input without weakening the dossier judge contract.
steps: Replay historical late-gap and duplicate-query logs through the current isolated-thread, compact-prior, gap-replacement, plateau, and zero-yield controls.
Normalize and deduplicate exact search queries and stop repeated terminal transport failures within one run.
Measure tokens, wall time, tool calls, fetch failures, independent retained sources, KIQ closures, contradiction resolutions, and forecast-input changes per pass.
Stop a pass when marginal evidence yield is exhausted, while retaining explicit uncovered gaps rather than inventing completion.
Verify actor, source, citation, judge, extraction, and publication contracts are no weaker than the historical accepted baseline.

description: Report retries and optional forecast ensembles reuse invariant work and never regenerate full prose, translation, visualization, and audit artifacts when only a structured probability vector is required.
steps: Split report telemetry into section writing, extraction, repair, translation, audit, visualization, and retry operations.
Keep the default forecast seed count at one until a forecast-only ensemble path is verified.
Generate an extra ensemble seed as a structured forecast vector without a full prose report, translation, visual render, or publication audit.
Bound language-purity and section repair to the affected content instead of escalating to whole-report regeneration or unbounded sequential calls.
Resume a report-only pipeline after a completed simulation and verify the sealed simulation is reused without any repeated simulation calls.
Resume a partial simulation from its last sealed round and verify completed rounds and their provider calls are not replayed.
Verify published report bytes and audit identities remain immutable while sidecar ensemble evidence is separately sealed.
Compare calls, tokens, latency, probability output, and publication integrity against the historical full-report ensemble baseline.

description: After separate paid-run authorization, one fresh controlled pipeline proves the optimized current source reduces cost and latency without degrading evidence, forecast, market, simulation, artifact, or UI quality.
steps: Obtain explicit authorization for exactly one new paid run and record the prompt, model, provider, configuration, budget, and immutable baseline comparison contract.
Launch exactly one pipeline and verify no duplicate POST, healthy heartbeats, provider identity, and per-request ledger activity from the first call.

Capture per-stage and per-substage calls, reconciled measured tokens, explicitly labeled estimates and lower bounds, cache usage, cost, wall time, retries, errors, evidence yield, and degradation receipts.
Verify all six stage artifacts, cross-stage hashes, market provenance, diagnostic simulation policy, report audit, visualization manifest, translation or PDF if requested, and localhost presentation.
Compare against the historical reference runs and reject any optimization that saves resources by weakening source coverage, judge outcomes, provenance, or publication quality.
Record exact results and decide the next single improvement slice from measured residual bottlenecks.

description: Deep-research engine v3 (RESEARCH_ENGINE=v3, default): bounded agentic KIQ research with provider prompt caching, verified citations/numbers, canonical scenario frame, resumable phases and honest exit codes, accepted unchanged by the parent pipeline.
steps: Run the engine offline with the test fakes (English and Chinese, quick/standard/deep) and verify rc 0, a report >= 400 chars, positional [S#] == sources.json == References, and the canonical scenario block parsed by forecast_inputs_from_report_markdown.

Verify byte-identical [ENGINE_CORE][RUN BRIEF][shared context] prefixes across sibling calls and agent steps, prime() before each fan-out, one [usage] line per provider call with cached= tokens, and unchanged GLM request bodies.

Fault-inject provider outage, quota, content filter, deadline, budget, empty/unparseable replies and tool outages in every phase; verify deterministic degradation with research_quality.degraded events, or a resumable exit 2 for outages/no model output/no evidence, and correct resume.
Drive the real PipelineOrchestrator research stage with a child process and verify acceptance, reception of the unsealed actor plane, audit-only lint, telemetry and reuse on a second run.
Owner-gated: one live GLM-5.3 run confirming cache hits and provider acceptance of the thinking/reasoning_effort/max_tokens parameters.

description: Use the producer roster multiplicity digest in actor-context admission while preserving identity and tamper rejection.
steps: Pass a real producer contract through parent admission and context compilation.
Reject changed and duplicate identities with the existing fail-closed contracts.
Run actor producer, parent and context regression suites under the main offline guard.

description: Display dossier translation from the actual backend response envelope and keep asynchronous results bound to the selected report.
steps: Load and generate translations through the compiled component methods using the backend envelope.
Exercise available, generating, interrupted, failed and stale-report responses.
Run the frontend regression suite and isolated production build.

description: Integrate the six bundled official data MCPs into v3 and legacy research, citable persisted observations, research and forecast visualizations, bounded public context and exact-evidence forecast resolution.
steps: Retrieve source-shaped data through bounded MCP adapters, retaining missing values, observation status, units, time and provenance.
Use agent data tools and quantitative planning in both research engines and bind snapshots to citations before sealing.
Promote the same data generation and render accurate charts in research and forecast reports, including fiscal periods and bilingual captions.
Admit only eligible historical context and exact-period anchors, preserving actor authority and immutable resolution outcomes.
Verify disabled/unavailable behavior, deployment wiring, reviewed source hashes, end-to-end transport and report artifact delivery without live model or saved-run mutations.
note: Reset 2026-10-12 by the data-sources review (the eac717b evidence was offline only); passing again 2026-10-14 on live evidence. Plain pytest is green apart from the 2 pre-existing demo-asset failures (6008 passed), and the guarded runner end-to-end passes. Live catalog smoke: fred 83, bls 45, bis 50, imf 6 (capped), wb 54, usgov 51. Owner-approved three-question live v3 eval: every run exited 0, with a data baseline, 5, 7 and 8 official-data figures, official sources, quantitative rows and forecast indicators. See docs/handoff/data-sources-mcp/eval/results-2026-10-14.md. The forecast-report stage is verified offline only.

description: Nine project-tailored research method skills (industry research, industry forecasting, competitive landscape, macro, policy and trade, geopolitics, elections, financial markets, reference-class forecasting, plus 21 sector adapters) that a deterministic bilingual router injects into the planning, KIQ, gap and writing phases of both research engines.
steps: Ask an industry, macro, policy, geopolitical, election, market or ranking question in English or Chinese and confirm the router picks the matching method skills (meta.research_skills).

Confirm the v3 planner gets the skills' Plan sections, each KIQ task its Investigate method and sector adapters, the gap review the Gaps checks and the writers the Synthesize contract, with the method text only at the end of the last message.
Confirm plan.json keeps the chosen skills so a resumed run rebuilds identical tasks, and that actors.json forecast_inputs carries the extracted base rates and drivers.
Confirm the legacy engine names the routed skills with read_file pointers and gives its workers and synthesis the same method cards.
Confirm RESEARCH_SKILLS=off leaves every prompt, tool, artifact and meta key byte-identical and that a missing or malformed skill never fails a run.
In a live run, confirm the agents' notes and the report follow the routed method (base-rate KIQ, method exhibits, signposts).
note: Steps 1-5 verified offline 2026-10-16: tests/test_research_skills.py (133 cases incl. 40+ real EN/ZH routing cases and false-positive guards), the scripted full-run test test_e2e_method_skills_reach_every_phase_and_fill_the_forecast_frame (skills on and off), the guarded-runner end-to-end and the full backend suite. Step 6 needs a paid live run, which needs owner approval. Design and review records: docs/handoff/research-skills/ (design.md, review-results.md).

description: The multi-agent simulation evolves an explicit world state every calendar round: actors observe the committed world, make one structured, motivated decision from a realistic option set (goals, incentives, alliances, constraints, capacity), publish it, and a single world update (deterministic kernel + bounded arbiter) changes facts, relationships and pending consequences that every agent observes next round.
steps: Start a calendar-mode run; PREPARE seals a world_model block (state variables from quantitative facts and official data, actor agency classes, valenced relationships) into simulation_config.json.

In round 1 every deciding actor receives the WORLD STATE brief plus a grounded option menu and returns a structured decision; its public statement appears as its post on both platforms (one decision per actor per round).

After both platforms deliver the round, exactly one world update commits: facts change with recorded causes, commitments register, relationships shift, scheduled events fire; world_state.json and world_state_history.jsonl are written and a world_update row lands in actions.jsonl.

In round 2 the WORLD CLOCK note and every decision prompt show the round-1 consequences (changed facts with their previous values, moves, events, alliance shifts, pending commitments) and no scenario probabilities.
A failed arbiter call still commits the round mechanically with arbiter_status=failed; SIM_WORLD_MODEL=false and hours mode produce no world artifacts and run the legacy path unchanged.
The dashboard simulation tab shows the World State panel, run_summary.json carries a world_model block, and the report's diagnostic pack renders the world evolution and a world-variables chart.
A live run (real LLM) shows actors reacting to world changes across rounds; a human review confirms the moves are realistic for each actor's agency class.
note: Offline: tests/test_world_model*.py, test_agent_decision.py, test_world_update.py, test_world_model_loop.py (2026-10-16). Live (owner-approved, 2026-10-16/17): pipe_d569f211eb14 / sim_d6ebcc77e22d on glm-5.3, 9 monthly rounds, 7 agents: arbiter applied 7/9 (2 provider content-filter rejections committed mechanically), 50 valid decisions with 12 distinct option ids by agency class, one decision per actor per round on both platforms, 11 caused fact changes inside the clamp, rounds 39-140 s vs the 1800 s barrier, dashboard panel + run_summary + report chart/block verified. Evidence: docs/handoff/reflexive-world-state/handoff.md section 7 'Live run'. Follow-ups listed there (section 9).

description: Replace social-only simulation with an explicitly pinned world engine whose actors change concrete resources, commitments, rules and relationships over time and respond to permitted consequences, preserving legacy runs and forecast evidence boundaries.
steps: Compile research and actor evidence into versioned world and role models with explicit assumptions and private knowledge boundaries.
Execute investment/supply, policy/trade and coalition/institution scenarios through one causal proposal-response-resolution-commit loop.
Verify conservation, authority, consent, timing, private prompts, durable attempts and crash/resume closure.
Run the actual pipeline/direct API child lifecycle with immutable input pins, cancellation, forks and strict committed completion.
Read matching world/decisions/commitments/assumptions through UI, report, chat, charts, translation and export; isolate evidence-only probabilities under pinned safe policy.
Complete reviewed offline gates and the approved maximum US$25 held-out live evaluation before default admission or model-realism claims.

description: Integrate exact default-world promise fulfilment with main and close durable published forecast resolution scoring and next-report track record.
steps: Run real commitment consequences and actor feedback through restart on current main.
Publish a forecast through actual final audit and retain immutable probabilities and resolution identities.
Resolve market/data binaries and a manually adjudicated scenario through native monitor and SDK paths.
Retry and restart without duplicate scores or changed original evidence; reject invalid identities and conflicting outcomes.
Generate the next report and verify frozen typed track record in forecast JSON, audited Markdown and API/download consumers.

description: Both research engines use bounded NewsAPI discovery and optional Reddit context with persisted provider/time/status metadata, fetched-source citations and immutable replay.
steps: Run a controlled forecast through the actual research engine and observe news_search invocation, bounded provider acquisition, publisher-page fetch and cited final research output.
Verify invalid credentials, rate limits, forbidden social access, empty results, deadlines, disabled mode and duplicate queries retain distinct states without leaking credentials.
Promote the sealed context generation through the parent and replay/resume without refetch; reject tampering and changed-input reuse.

description: Research agents compare provider-qualified Polymarket and Kalshi context using current source shapes, honest units and availability without external automatic forecast anchors.
steps: Invoke market_compare with native-shaped current Polymarket/Kalshi responses and retain identity, quote basis, rules, units, times and source links in the sealed context.
Exercise absent prices, reversed outcomes, native ID collisions, differing horizons/rules, pagination failures and provider access errors without fabricating probabilities or equivalence.
Trace context into research and report consumers and assert external IDs never reach Gamma/CLOB refresh, automatic anchors or resolution. Record live compatibility separately.

description: The exact sealed news/social/external-market context reaches ordinary, manual, seed and ensemble report entrypoints, audited Markdown and API/UI/export with immutable generation binding.
steps: Run a controlled source-to-research-to-handoff-to-report publication scenario and verify identical provider/capture/source identities and context-only labels at the API and Markdown/PDF export boundary.
Verify dossier and forecast UI render bounded safe linked evidence with times, source types, explicit empty/unavailable statuses and English/Chinese labels.
Exercise stale/tampered generations, old handoffs, disabled behavior, multi-track merges and scenario reuse without provider refetch or actor/world-state privilege expansion.

description: Simulation, research dossier and forecast views translate visible prose and structured content predominantly into Mandarin while preserving source-bound facts and reliable retry behavior.
steps: Reproduce the actual saved numeric-token failure, prevent identifier/year fusion and malformed date ranges, and reject changed factual units, signs, currencies, IDs, code and links.
Translate current and historical simulation projections, personas, feed/replies and structured world content without exposing unrendered private state or dropping long-page tails.
Translate dossier body/cards/datasets and forecast dashboard/binaries/title/captions, retaining explicit partial and pending states, cancellation and source/run/language identity.
Exercise persistence, restart, tamper/publication/SDK controls, large-page progress, shared provider admission and structured-only retry without regenerating accepted Markdown.
Verify frozen service/API and actual SFC consumers, independent red-to-green review and bounded local browser/provider behavior; document remaining limitations and deliver reviewed code.

description: Explicit forecast endpoints reach the simulation calendar and actor clocks; arbiter and model-led translation producers receive exact consumer contracts.
steps: Replay the original gold and war end-2027 prompts through native timeline, persisted config, round loop, actor clocks and durable outputs.
Preserve numeric registry types and exact promise/action/recipient bindings through actor decisions, arbitration and next-round feedback.
Repair only failed whole translation sections using bounded parser differences while keeping semantic review and source-bound publication strict.
Skip non-simulation files during orphan inventory; preserve completed run artifacts and verify guarded native regressions and independent review.

description: Default forecast preparation pins a reviewed typed objective, arbitration validates transactions before mutation, and primary grounding preserves parsed source structure.
steps: Extract and separately verify the original task endpoint once, seal its source/budget/clock identity, reject contradictory or stale preparation, and validate runtime/report consumers including restart.
Reject malformed arbiter proposals atomically; permit one correction and preserve deterministic-only failure, exact commitment ownership and typed durable audit attempts.
Reproduce primary Markdown corruption from valid writer output and repair only parser-confirmed source spans while retaining quantitative/citation/publication gates.
Verify native producer-to-publication/API/export controls, independent regressions, historical preservation, and safe local activation with peer work preserved.

description: Publish a faithful public-only per-period simulation record and a deterministic labelled report bridge while keeping research-based forecast prompts and probabilities isolated from simulated trajectories.
steps: Complete or reuse an OASIS or world-v1 run; compile and gate its after-action record without rerunning a simulation for a missing derivative.
Open the Simulation record and switch periods to inspect public moves, state changes, commitments and limits; reject stale/failed records through every API route.
Generate reports from two different simulated trajectories over identical research; verify identical research prompts, probabilities and prose outside the bridge.
Verify diagnostic_only produces exactly one validated bridge and no_update omits simulated report content and links while retaining the separate record.
Reject private material, fabricated citations, modified seals, malformed bridge fences and translated bridge substitutions.
Exercise browser record navigation plus relevant guarded backend/frontend scenarios and build on the delivered source; distinguish this proof from live model quality/calibration.

description: Research-grounded PREPARE preserves native quantitative baselines and actor-specific qualitative context in sealed actual persona, environment, native and default runtime consumers.
steps: Prepare an exact admitted generation with official observations, targets, public and private actor claims.
Verify complete native units, periods, statuses and source identities reach actual intended consumers only.
Restart and verify matching artifacts; reject tampered or replacement inputs before dispatch.

description: Research revises initial scenario assessments using bounded sourced post-gather evidence, preserving definitions, reasons and honest support states.
steps: Gather source assertions and deduplicate evidence identity.
Run a bounded versioned assessment and retain initial/final frames with reasons.
Verify numeric occurrence alone is unassessed and probability spread is diagnostic.

description: Fresh default worlds enforce affordable actions and typed operative agreement deadlines, with replay-complete accepted transitions.
steps: Exercise costly actions, menu coverage, mutual consent and future deliveries.
Verify unaffordable actions have no effects and delivery dates do not become offer expiry.
Replay accepted deterministic and arbiter updates without model calls and reject drift.

description: Explicit config-pinned adaptive branches use branch-local observations, decisions, shares and durable bounded dispatch accounting.
steps: Enable an explicit finite adaptive envelope and freeze initial personas.
Diverge branches and observe different subsequent scripted decisions and local discourse.
Restart without refunding reserved calls or substituting primary branch observations.

description: Simulation diagnostics produce bounded hypothetical research questions without granting simulation evidence authority.
steps: Finalize a simulation with surprising dynamics or gaps.
Verify capped deduplicated questions retain hypothetical status and input provenance.
Verify unchanged factual report/probability authority and explicit stopping reasons.

description: Evaluation retains all enrolled questions and event families with explicit failed, unresolved and void dispositions and qualified controlled contrasts.
steps: Enroll cases before outcomes and join accepted predictions/resolutions.
Verify every enrolled case contributes to counts or explicit unscored disposition.
Reject misleading probability-lift claims from diagnostic-only or unequal-cost comparisons.

description: Existing deep-research and forecast PDF buttons run the versioned equity-research-pdf skill through a bounded source-preserving formatting and page-review agent, then download only verified selected-language artifacts.
steps: Start from codex/research-pdf-export based on main.
Click each original report PDF control and observe its own resource-scoped background job.
Verify source/translation admission and immutable complete component/asset snapshots.
Prove the agent consumes the actual skill and full source, invokes the real renderer, and reviews every page without text-only fallback or fabricated approvals.
Validate exact report/language PDF bytes, figures, tables, links and fonts; reject stale sources, incomplete reviews, corrupted output and duplicate work.
Exercise retry/interruption/cancellation and late UI responses; preserve canonical sources and prior valid exports.
Pass guarded backend, frontend, native PDF, independent review and browser gates; record separately any live-provider capability result.
